questions.q: What is the role of SQL Server Agent jobs in a backup automation strategy?
options: They turn scheduled backup commands (full, differential, log) into something that runs unattended, on a defined schedule
They replace the need for any BACKUP DATABASE statement entirely
They are only used for index maintenance, never for backups
They automatically design the backup strategy's RPO for you
questions.explain: Agent jobs are the native mechanism for running the backup commands from Lesson 2 on a recurring schedule without manual intervention.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what is the real, honest industry-standard way most production shops automate SQL Server backups?
options: Ola Hallengren's free Maintenance Solution scripts, particularly the DatabaseBackup stored procedure
Writing a unique hand-rolled Agent job step for every single database on the instance
Relying entirely on Windows Task Scheduler instead of SQL Server Agent
There is no real standard — every shop invents its own from scratch
questions.explain: Ola Hallengren's scripts are widely deployed and handle backup, verification, and cleanup logic that hand-rolled jobs would otherwise have to re-solve.

questions.q: What does the @CleanupTime parameter do in Ola Hallengren's DatabaseBackup procedure?
options: It automatically deletes backup files older than the specified number of hours
It sets how long the backup job is allowed to run before timing out
It determines how often log backups run
It encrypts backup files older than the given threshold
questions.explain: @CleanupTime = 336, for example, deletes backup files older than 336 hours (14 days), preventing old backups from silently filling a disk.

questions.q: How does @Verify = 'Y' in DatabaseBackup relate to Lesson 5's verification content?
options: It automatically runs RESTORE VERIFYONLY against every backup taken, building Lesson 5's verification step directly into the automated process
It has no relationship to backup verification at all
It performs a full test restore to a scratch instance automatically
It only verifies encrypted backups, not compressed ones
questions.explain: @Verify = 'Y' wires RESTORE VERIFYONLY into the automated backup job itself, though this lesson is clear that VERIFYONLY alone is still not the same as a full test restore.

questions.q: A shop's hand-rolled Agent jobs run BACKUP DATABASE for a fixed list of database names. Six months later, three new databases exist and receive no backups. What about DatabaseBackup called with @Databases = 'USER_DATABASES' would have prevented this?
options: USER_DATABASES dynamically includes all user databases on the instance at run time, rather than a fixed list that goes stale as databases are added
It wouldn't have helped — DatabaseBackup also requires a fixed, manually maintained database list
New databases are backed up automatically regardless of which method is used
USER_DATABASES only refers to system databases, not user-created ones
questions.explain: Because USER_DATABASES is evaluated dynamically each time the job runs, newly created databases are picked up automatically without any job modification — exactly the gap a fixed, hand-rolled list creates.
